header: Printing the Quarterly, from plate to pallet
subheadline: Four issues a year, 4,200 copies each, printed 12 minutes from the Vienna office. These are the steps from signed proof to the pallet for the mailing house.

items.title: Plate check, 07:00
items.description: All 96 pages are checked against the signed proof before any plate goes on the press.

items.title: First clean sheets
items.description: At 09:30 the colour is matched to the reference print. Two pages usually need a second pass before the run continues.

items.title: Binding and pallet
items.description: The full run of 4,200 copies is trimmed, bound and stacked by late afternoon, ready for the mailing house.
